scope: P0-5, P0-6, P0-7, P0-8; typed Server MEF rules; no new game execution

ids.instanceId: one runtime encounter session; never content-shared mutable state
ids.nodeId: authored node identity, not MapID or original SourceNode
ids.waveId: Ordinal/case-sensitive within current node; WaveCleared/WaveHealthReached null means nonempty initial group; requiredBoss null has different semantics.
ids.actorId: Combat allocator appends unique actor slot IDs for this encounter; never waveId, Model or PRE; old dead slots retained through removal.
ids.requiredBoss: model+PRE with optional waveId; omitted waveId searches every initial/sequential/timed actor in the node, named id only that wave; exactly one matching configured actor required by typed loader.
ids.flagId: unique producer within definition, monotonic per instance
ids.exitKey: per-node identity; openness must be tested for this exact key

ReadyToReturn.required_boss_if_configured: matching actor HP zero AND RemoveAt null

clear_gate.death_removal: deadline due AND no enemy projectile sourced from that actor; packet appended then RemoveAt cleared

documented_partial_order.before: timed reinforcement pass in array order
selected unlocked key and accepted position

documented_partial_order.after: publish selected node or current Portal points

partial_order_limit: These are pinned consumer phases. RegionEntered produced after combat Poll need not unlock a wave in that same update; NodeDelay observed before Poll may. No arbitrary event callback replaces an eligible update or story commit.

wave_health.existing_optimization: callback only when HP total changed; cleared wave removed from observation list

timers.eligibility: expanded ordinary encounter, alive player, due time, ALL requiredFlags and current activationRegion
timers.phase: timed array order; waiting entry does not block later eligible entries; before sequential attempt
timers.reset: entry origin survives other waves; a newly constructed combat has new origin
timers.story_detail: committed Combat transition recreates combat after entry scene; do not count earlier pre-scene allocation as this combat origin

timers.origin: first eligible sequential attempt observing aggregate HP zero while a next sequential wave exists
timers.eligibility: same normal combat guards, next array element, aggregate empty, time, ALL flags and current region
timers.phase: one sequential wave per eligible Poll, after timed pass
timers.reset: any spawned reinforcement clears empty interval and victory wait; living timed wave prevents sequential progress

timers.origin: first eligible sequential pass in combat Poll observing the empty initial encounter
timers.comparison: same Add comparison as C2; zero delay may spawn in that update
timers.eligibility: no fabricated null WaveCleared/WaveHealth signal; necessary timed and sequential waves remain counted
timers.phase: after timed pass; a due timed wave may occupy the field before sequential clock starts

timers.origin: scenario ActivateNodeTimer; story only in Encounter phase, lab/ordinary node activation
timers.eligibility: entered, not completed, activated; existing eligible adapter update
timers.phase: normal world observer before combat Poll; can unlock same Poll wave
timers.reset: new node Enter resets origin; story fork copies it
timers.story_detail: entry scene precedes activation; clear scene elapsed time continues but locked dispatch waits until eligible update/committed Portal observation

timers.origin: first valid ObservePosition after GroupIsCleared; story first eligible observation in committed Portal phase
timers.eligibility: entered, not completed, finite accepted position and cleared group
timers.phase: position observer then exit reevaluation; not a global combat deadline
timers.reset: new node Enter; save/clear-cinematic time before first observation does not prepay delay

timers.origin: first eligible accepted observation in current region
timers.eligibility: canHold and inside region; flags once latched remain set
timers.phase: position observer; first in-region observation records start without immediate completion
timers.reset: observed leave, canHold false/death or story clear planning resets unfinished hold; flags already completed survive

duration_conversion.clock: one injected TimeProvider shared by world/scenario/combat; world defaults TimeProvider.System; no assumed fixed TimestampFrequency
duration_conversion.combat_numeric_semantics: multiply using deployed double semantics, convert product to long toward zero, then checked timestamp addition; finite nonnegative wave delay is bounded 0..3600; do not replace with decimal math, round or ceil
duration_conversion.scenario_elapsed: preserve exact GetElapsedTime(...).TotalSeconds API and comparison with authored double; no explicit Add conversion in these observers
duration_conversion.framework_scope: Use the same injected provider and deployed .NET GetElapsedTime/TimeSpan behavior. This analysis does not independently reimplement the framework or assume its runtime timestamp frequency.
duration_conversion.timer_queue_requirement: Queue may select candidates, but final due predicate and original eligible phase must remain identical, especially for elapsed-time observers.

branch.graph: finite acyclic, all nodes reachable, every path ends in Result
branch.merge_flags: intersection of those post-exit guarantee sets across every incoming route
branch.selector: explicit key selects only that key; without key nearest then lower key
branch.commit: fork plan then publish after existing story commit
branch.new_instance: reset flags/wave cursors/timers; reuse existing permanent asset/quest journal services
branch.post_exit_guarantees: incoming guaranteed flags UNION GroupCleared/BossDefeated/all wave-observation signal flags UNION all necessary wave requiredFlags UNION selected exit requiredFlags; then transitive interaction prerequisites

projection: Flags trigger consumer reevaluation; do not directly impersonate actor HP, inventory mutation, completion receipt or Client callback.

scope_completion.P0-7: finite repeat helper, once-per-entry weighted selector and typed service extension contracts analyzed; runtime adapters not deployed
scope_completion.P0-8: six origins, phases and exact deployed code conversion families analyzed; scheduler equivalence requirements explicit

registration.functional_lab: hardcoded mode-to-definition catalog; new IDs require explicit registration
registration.story_override: must bind pinned narrative and preserve node count, numbered maps and initial model order; generic finite-repeat input is not automatically compatible
